SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ja_conversation_message source JOIN ja_conversation_timeline_entry source_item ON source_item.item_id=source.message_id AND source_item.thread_id=source.thread_id AND source_item.turn_id=source.turn_id AND source_item.message_kind='USER_INPUT' JOIN ja_conversation_turn owner ON owner.turn_id=source.turn_id AND owner.thread_id=source.thread_id AND owner.is_current_path=1 WHERE source.thread_id=#{threadId} AND source.message_id=#{sourceMessageId} AND source.role='USER' AND source.message_id=( SELECT latest.item_id FROM ja_conversation_timeline_entry latest JOIN ja_conversation_message latest_message ON latest_message.message_id=latest.item_id AND latest_message.thread_id=latest.thread_id AND latest_message.turn_id=latest.turn_id JOIN ja_conversation_turn latest_turn ON latest_turn.turn_id=latest.turn_id AND latest_turn.thread_id=latest.thread_id AND latest_turn.is_current_path=1 WHERE latest.thread_id=#{threadId} AND latest.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND latest_message.role='USER' ORDER BY latest_message.ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_conversation_timeline_entry earlier JOIN ja_conversation_message earlier_message ON earlier_message.message_id=earlier.item_id WHERE earlier.thread_id=source.thread_id AND earlier.turn_id=owner.turn_id AND earlier.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND earlier_message.role='USER' AND earlier_message.ordinal<source.ordinal) AND (SELECT latest_attempt.state FROM ja_conversation_turn latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.thread_id=source.thread_id AND latest_attempt.is_current_path=1 AND (latest_attempt.turn_id=owner.turn_id OR latest_attempt.source_message_id=source.message_id) ORDER BY latest_attempt.turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_conversation_turn successful WHERE successful.thread_id=source.thread_id AND successful.is_current_path=1 AND successful.state='COMPLETED' AND (successful.turn_id=owner.turn_id OR successful.source_message_id=source.message_id)) )

UPDATE ja_conversation_thread SET last_seen_turn_sequence=( SELECT turn_sequence FROM ja_conversation_turn WHERE ja_conversation_turn.thread_id=ja_conversation_thread.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1), updated_at_ms=#{occurredAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at_ms IS NULL AND (SELECT state FROM ja_conversation_turn WHERE ja_conversation_turn.thread_id=ja_conversation_thread.thread_id AND is_current_path=1 ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') AND COALESCE(last_seen_turn_sequence,0)<( SELECT turn_sequence FROM ja_conversation_turn WHERE ja_conversation_turn.thread_id=ja_conversation_thread.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1)

WITH call_owners AS ( SELECT p.thread_id,p.turn_id,p.call_id,MIN(m.message_id) AS context_message_id, MIN(m.ordinal) AS context_message_ordinal FROM ja_tool_call_preview p JOIN ja_conversation_message m ON m.thread_id=p.thread_id AND m.turn_id=p.turn_id AND m.core_record_id=p.assistant_message_record_id GROUP BY p.thread_id,p.turn_id,p.call_id ), items AS ( SELECT e.item_id,'message' AS item_kind,e.created_at_ms,e.turn_id,NULL AS call_id,NULL AS tool_name, NULL AS tool_ordinal,NULL AS tool_state,e.kind AS message_kind,e.preview_text,e.total_characters,e.model_round, NULL AS presentation_json,NULL AS approval_id,NULL AS decision,NULL AS expires_at_ms, CASE WHEN e.kind='USER_INPUT' THEN COALESCE(( SELECT json_group_array(json_object('attachmentId',ordered.attachment_id,'displayName',ordered.display_name, 'sizeBytes',ordered.size_bytes,'mediaKind',lower(ordered.media_kind),'mediaType',ordered.media_type)) FROM (SELECT a.attachment_id,a.display_name,a.size_bytes,a.media_kind,a.media_type FROM json_each(e.attachments_json) metadata JOIN ja_attachment a ON a.attachment_id=json_extract(metadata.value,'$.attachmentId') ORDER BY json_extract(metadata.value,'$.ordinal')) ordered),json_array()) ELSE NULL END AS attachments_json, e.context_references_json,e.source_thread_id,e.source_title,e.message_id AS context_message_id,m.ordinal AS context_message_ordinal, e.sequence AS timeline_sequence,x.turn_sequence AS turn_sequence FROM ja_conversation_timeline_entry e JOIN ja_conversation_turn x ON x.turn_id=e.turn_id AND x.thread_id=e.thread_id LEFT JOIN ja_conversation_message m ON m.message_id=e.message_id AND m.thread_id=e.thread_id AND m.turn_id=e.turn_id WHERE e.thread_id=#{threadId} AND e.is_current_path=1 AND x.is_current_path=1
UNION ALL SELECT t.thread_id||':'||t.turn_id||':'||t.call_id||'_call','tool_call',t.created_at_ms,t.turn_id,t.call_id, t.tool_name,t.ordinal,t.state,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, CASE WHEN t.state='PREPARED' AND json_extract(t.presentation_json,'$.status')='pending' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_approval a WHERE a.thread_id=t.thread_id AND a.turn_id=t.turn_id AND a.call_id=t.call_id AND a.decision IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_conversation_turn waiting WHERE waiting.thread_id=t.thread_id AND waiting.turn_id=t.turn_id AND waiting.state='WAITING_APPROVAL') THEN json_set(t.presentation_json,'$.status','waiting_approval') ELSE t.presentation_json END, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,owner.context_message_id,owner.context_message_ordinal, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(e.sequence) FROM ja_conversation_timeline_entry e WHERE e.thread_id=t.thread_id AND e.turn_id=t.turn_id AND e.message_id=owner.context_message_id),0),x.turn_sequence FROM ja_tool_call t JOIN ja_conversation_turn x ON x.turn_id=t.turn_id AND x.thread_id=t.thread_id LEFT JOIN call_owners owner ON owner.thread_id=t.thread_id AND owner.turn_id=t.turn_id AND owner.call_id=t.call_id WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.is_current_path=1 UNION ALL SELECT a.approval_id,'approval',a.requested_at_ms,a.turn_id,a.call_id,t.tool_name,NULL,NULL, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,a.approval_id,a.decision,a.expires_at_ms,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL ,owner.context_message_id,owner.context_message_ordinal, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(e.sequence) FROM ja_conversation_timeline_entry e WHERE e.thread_id=a.thread_id AND e.turn_id=a.turn_id AND e.message_id=owner.context_message_id),0),x.turn_sequence FROM ja_approval a JOIN ja_tool_call t ON t.thread_id=a.thread_id AND t.turn_id=a.turn_id AND t.call_id=a.call_id JOIN ja_conversation_turn x ON x.turn_id=a.turn_id AND x.thread_id=a.thread_id LEFT JOIN call_owners owner ON owner.thread_id=a.thread_id AND owner.turn_id=a.turn_id AND owner.call_id=a.call_id WHERE a.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.is_current_path=1 ), ordered_items AS ( SELECT *,CASE WHEN message_kind='USER_INPUT' THEN 0 WHEN message_kind='REASONING_SUMMARY' THEN 1 WHEN message_kind='ASSISTANT_PROGRESS' THEN 2 WHEN item_kind='tool_call' THEN 3 WHEN item_kind='approval' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS semantic_order,COALESCE(tool_ordinal,-1) AS ordinal_order FROM items)
mapper.select: SELECT item_id,item_kind,created_at_ms,turn_id,call_id,tool_name,tool_ordinal,tool_state,message_kind, preview_text,total_characters,model_round,presentation_json,approval_id,decision,expires_at_ms,attachments_json, context_references_json,source_thread_id,source_title,context_message_id,context_message_ordinal, timeline_sequence,turn_sequence,semantic_order,ordinal_order FROM ordered_items WHERE item_id=#{itemId} LIMIT 1

WITH latest_attempt AS ( SELECT source_message_id,MAX(turn_sequence) AS latest_sequence FROM ja_conversation_turn WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND is_current_path=1 AND source_message_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_message_id ) SELECT owner.turn_id FROM latest_attempt attempt JOIN ja_conversation_message source ON source.message_id=attempt.source_message_id AND source.thread_id=#{threadId} AND source.role='USER' JOIN ja_conversation_turn owner ON owner.turn_id=source.turn_id AND owner.thread_id=source.thread_id UNION SELECT previous.turn_id FROM latest_attempt attempt JOIN ja_conversation_turn previous ON previous.thread_id=#{threadId} AND previous.is_current_path=1 AND previous.source_message_id=attempt.source_message_id AND previous.turn_sequence<attempt.latest_sequence

SELECT u.turn_id,u.model_request_id,u.model_round,u.model_request_ordinal,u.purpose,u.certainty, u.profile_json,u.input_tokens,u.output_tokens,u.total_tokens,u.cache_read_tokens,u.cache_write_tokens, u.new_input_tokens,u.input_accounting,u.estimated_context_tokens,u.created_at_ms AS occurred_at_ms FROM ja_turn_usage u JOIN ja_conversation_turn x ON x.turn_id=u.turn_id WHERE u.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.is_current_path=1 AND u.purpose='ASSISTANT' ORDER BY x.turn_sequence DESC,u.model_request_ordinal DESC,u.usage_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS measured_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_input_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN new_input_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND output_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS output_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND output_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN output_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN total_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_read_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN cache_read_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_read_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_write_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN cache_write_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_write_tokens,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL AND (cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL OR input_accounting='INPUT_INCLUDES_CACHE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_complete_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL AND (cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL OR input_accounting='INPUT_INCLUDES_CACHE') THEN CASE WHEN input_accounting='INPUT_INCLUDES_CACHE' THEN input_tokens ELSE new_input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens END ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_complete_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL AND (cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL OR input_accounting='INPUT_INCLUDES_CACHE') THEN cache_read_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_complete_read_tokens FROM ja_turn_usage WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND purpose IN ('ASSISTANT','SUMMARY')

SELECT a.artifact_id,a.sha256,a.content,a.byte_length FROM ja_change_set_artifact a JOIN ja_conversation_thread t ON t.thread_id=a.thread_id AND t.deleted_at_ms IS NULL JOIN ja_conversation_turn x ON x.turn_id=a.turn_id AND x.thread_id=a.thread_id WHERE a.thread_id=#{threadId} AND a.turn_id=#{turnId} AND a.artifact_id=#{artifactId} AND x.state IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
